description: This file defines a PromptManager class that manages loading, parsing, rendering, and converting prompt templates following the Dotprompt specification. It handles frontmatter parsing, template rendering with Jinja2, input validation, and supports loading prompts from files, directories, or JSON data.

classes.name: PromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a single prompt template with associated metadata and content.

classes.name: PromptManager
classes.description: Manages loading, parsing, rendering, and converting prompt templates following the Dotprompt format.
